AWPTCM-T33247.objective:
• The clear arp-cache command removes all dynamic ARP entries from the ARP table.
  • Static ARP entries are not removed by the clear arp-cache command.
  • The clear arp-cache command updates both the software ARP table (show arp) and the hardware ARP table (ip neighbor / hsl fib).
  • After executing clear arp-cache, dynamic ARP entries no longer appear in show arp, show hsl fib, or ip neighbor output.
  • ARP entries learned after a clear arp-cache command are populated normally in both software and hardware tables.

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability.
Configure both static and dynamic ARP entries. Execute clear arp-cache and verify only dynamic entries are removed while static entries remain.
Verify that after clear arp-cache the dynamic ARP entries are removed from both the software table (show arp) and the hardware table (ip neighbor / show hsl fib).
After clearing dynamic ARP entries, trigger new ARP learning and confirm the new dynamic entries are correctly populated in both software and hardware tables.
Verify that static ARP entries can only be removed using the no arp command and are unaffected by clear arp-cache.
